## How it was tested

- [ ] `npm run lint` (at the root, or in the package)
- [ ] `agent`: `npm test`
- [ ] `app`: `npm test`
- [ ] Demo cluster has the data, healthy scenario still raises nothing
- [ ] Screenshot (phone width, dark and light) for UI changes
- [ ] Docs updated (CHECKS, COMPONENTS, CONFIGURATION, SECURITY as needed)
- [ ] Title as a [conventional commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`fix(agent): …`, `feat(app): …`): it becomes the changelog line
